The '''Reformists''' were a faction that existed within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The designs of the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] to enhance the capabilities of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] attracted support from some among the Reformists, and they worked with Tarkin to forge the Republic's [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] into a more effective fighting force.
